app.name: Solo Studio
app.summary: For a freelance UX designer juggling clients across inbox, notes, spreadsheets and back-and-forth booking emails. It centralizes clients with notes and follow-ups, client projects with tasks, and availability-based booking for discovery calls, design reviews and workshops. The designer manages everything from a home view of today's sessions, follow-ups and overdue tasks, while visitors self-book from a public page without accounts.
app.audience: Solo freelance UX designer; public visitors who book sessions

roles.description: Freelance designer who owns all data; manages clients, notes, projects, tasks, availability, session types and sessions.

assumptions.text: Each designer account has its own isolated workspace; there is no sharing, collaboration or team view. 'Just for me' means no other signed-in roles.
Client requires name and email only; company and profile are optional; status defaults to Lead and can be changed freely between Lead, Active, Past.

Each note has auto creation date, text, optional follow-up date and follow-up done flag. Due means follow-up date is set and not done; overdue means follow-up date is before today and not done; client list sorts overdue first then by earliest due date.
Mark follow-up done sets done flag and keeps the note; Push a week adds 7 days to the follow-up date and leaves it not done.

Task requires title only; status defaults to To do, priority defaults to Medium, due date optional. Ticking done sets status to Done. Overdue means due date is before today and status is not Done, shown highlighted.
Open tasks count means tasks with status To do or In progress.
Deleting a project deletes its tasks. Deleting a client deletes its projects and tasks, its notes, and its bookings; sessions themselves remain unless they have no bookings left.

Availability is weekly recurring days with start and end times. Open slots for the next two weeks are availability sliced into back-to-back slots of each session type duration, excluding past times, full slots and cancelled slots. Sessions cannot overlap regardless of type.

The three session types are pre-seeded: 30 minute discovery call free for 1 person, 60 minute design review INR 4,000 shown for information for 1 person, 2 hour Figma workshop INR 2,500 a seat for up to 8 people. Designer can create, edit and delete session types; prices are display-only text.

Booking email match is case-insensitive exact match to an existing client email. If no match, a new client is created as Lead with that name and email and empty company and profile. Cancelling a booking never deletes the client.
Booking confirmation shows a unique unguessable cancellation link on screen. Anyone with the link can view and cancel the booking without signing in. No emails are sent.
Home shows: sessions dated today, follow-ups not done with follow-up date up to end of the current week including overdue, and overdue tasks across all projects.
No mandatory setup before first value; after sign-up the designer lands on home and can add the first client immediately.

questions.question: Should slots include buffer time between sessions?
questions.whyItMatters: Changes slot generation rules and how many bookable slots appear.

questions.question: When you cancel a session slot, should bookers see anything beyond the slot disappearing?
questions.whyItMatters: With no emails, it changes whether any in-app notice or placeholder is needed.
questions.defaultAnswer: Slot and its bookings disappear from upcoming with no notification.
